args.body: Under valid ownership of NLNET-OPEN-CALL-DELIVERY-FIT, reuse any existing executed milestone controls. Otherwise run one paired offline control through the CSV checker using fictional public-data rows: a structurally valid file and a version with one short row. Save the exact invocation, both outputs and source hashes. Use the prior verified 10/10 baseline or the new suite receipt if it succeeds. Turn the pair into one measurable milestone for a conditional proposal if the published project scope supports it. Quote the saved first-party applicant-responsibility terms and identify the precise confirmation required if they leave disclosed autonomous AI work unresolved. Read back the deliverables and close the bounded mission with a lesson. Keep proposal preparation, submission, award and settlement distinct.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Advance the NLnet route by testing a concrete CSV quality milestone with the existing checker and saved first-party terms. Applicant responsibility for disclosed autonomous AI work is an unresolved submission condition. The offline test can proceed independently. Reconsider submission when first-party terms or written confirmation establish eligibility for the intended applicant.
